tools.name: signoz_aggregate_logs
tools.description: Use this when the user wants aggregate statistics over logs—counts, rates, averages, percentiles, or grouped/top-N breakdowns—not individual log records. Use signoz_search_logs for log rows and message inspection; use signoz_execute_builder_query only for queries this tool cannot express. Log fields are workspace-specific, so read signoz://logs/query-builder-guide and discover unfamiliar keys with signoz_get_field_keys. Defaults to the last 1 hour.

aggregateOn.description: Field name to aggregate on (e.g., 'response_time', 'duration'). Required for all aggregations except count and rate.

aggregation.description: Aggregation function to apply. One of: count, count_distinct, avg, sum, min, max, p50, p75, p90, p95, p99, rate

end.description: End time in unix milliseconds (optional). When both start and end are provided, they override timeRange.

filter.description: Filter expression using SigNoz search syntax (see signoz://logs/query-builder-guide). Combine conditions with AND, OR, and parentheses for precedence. Unknown keys hard-error; keys present in multiple contexts default to resource context. Disambiguate with attribute.<key> or resource.<key>. Log keys are workspace-specific — logs have no spec-mandated resource attributes, so even service.name is only present when the log pipeline sets it. Discover valid keys with signoz_get_field_keys, then confirm values with signoz_get_field_values, before filtering. Examples: "service.name = 'payment-svc' AND severity_text = 'ERROR'", "(severity_text = 'ERROR' OR body CONTAINS 'panic') AND k8s.namespace.name = 'prod'", "body.user.id = '123'". Combined with service/severity params using AND.

groupBy.description: Comma-separated list of field names to group results by (e.g., 'service.name' or 'service.name, severity_text'). Leave empty for a single aggregate value.

limit.description: Maximum number of groups to return (default: 100, max: 10000; higher values are clamped). For time_series queries, groups are ranked across the entire time range, so a short-lived spike can fall outside the selected top groups.

orderBy.description: How to order results. Format: '<expression> <direction>', e.g. 'count() desc' or 'avg(duration) asc'. Defaults to the aggregation expression descending.

requestType.description: Result shape. "scalar" (default) returns one value or a grouped/ranked table over the full time range; use it for totals, percentiles, and top lists. "time_series" returns time-bucketed values, with one series per group when grouped; use it for spikes, trends, changes over time, or questions about when something happened.

searchContext.description: Copy the user's entire original request verbatim, including any preflight or confirmation context; do not summarize, shorten, or omit clauses.

service.description: Shortcut filter for service name. Equivalent to adding service.name = '<value>' to filter. Fails with `key service.name not found` when this workspace's logs lack that attribute — then discover keys with signoz_get_field_keys(signal="logs", fieldContext="resource") and filter on an available key instead.

severity.description: Shortcut filter for severity_text. Common values include DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, and FATAL, but they are not an exhaustive enum. Discover values with signoz_get_field_values(signal="logs", name="severity_text", fieldContext="log").

start.description: Start time in unix milliseconds (optional). When both start and end are provided, they override timeRange.

stepInterval.description: Time bucket size in seconds for time_series mode (optional). When omitted, the backend auto-selects an appropriate interval. Only set this if the user explicitly requests a specific granularity. Examples: '60' (1 min), '3600' (1 hour), '86400' (1 day).

timeRange.description: Relative time range. Format: <number><unit> where unit is 'm' (minutes), 'h' (hours), or 'd' (days). Examples: '30m', '1h', '2h', '6h', '24h', '3d', '7d'. Ignored when both start and end are provided. Defaults to '1h'.

tools.name: signoz_aggregate_traces
tools.description: Use this when the user wants custom aggregate statistics over spans—counts, rates, latency percentiles, grouped/top-N breakdowns, or time series—not individual span rows or a full trace hierarchy. For the built-in operation table for one traced service, ranked by p99, use signoz_get_service_top_operations. Use signoz_search_traces for raw spans or trace-ID discovery, and signoz_get_trace_details for one known trace ID. Before calling, read signoz://traces/query-builder-guide; discover unfamiliar workspace fields with signoz_get_field_keys. Defaults to the last 1 hour.

aggregateOn.description: Field name to aggregate on (e.g., 'duration_nano'). Required for all aggregations except count and rate.

aggregation.description: Aggregation function to apply. One of: count, count_distinct, avg, sum, min, max, p50, p75, p90, p95, p99, rate

end.description: End time in unix milliseconds (optional). When both start and end are provided, they override timeRange.

error.description: Shortcut filter for error spans (true or false). Equivalent to adding has_error = true/false to filter.

filter.description: Filter expression using SigNoz search syntax (see signoz://traces/query-builder-guide). Combine conditions with AND, OR, and parentheses for precedence. Unknown keys hard-error; keys present in multiple contexts default to resource context. Disambiguate with attribute.<key>, resource.<key>, or span.<key>. Discover valid keys with signoz_get_field_keys, then confirm values with signoz_get_field_values, before filtering. Examples: "service.name = 'payment-svc' AND has_error = true", "http_method = 'POST' AND (has_error = true OR duration_nano > 1000000000)". Combined with service/operation/error/duration params using AND.

groupBy.description: Comma-separated list of field names to group results by (e.g., 'service.name' or 'service.name, name'). Leave empty for a single aggregate value.

limit.description: Maximum number of groups to return (default: 100, max: 10000; higher values are clamped). For time_series queries, groups are ranked across the entire time range, so a short-lived spike can fall outside the selected top groups.

maxDuration.description: Maximum span duration in nanoseconds. Example: '2000000000' for 2s.

minDuration.description: Minimum span duration in nanoseconds. Example: '500000000' for 500ms.

operation.description: Shortcut filter for span/operation name. Equivalent to adding name = '<value>' to filter.

orderBy.description: How to order results. Format: '<expression> <direction>', e.g. 'count() desc' or 'avg(duration_nano) asc'. Defaults to the aggregation expression descending.

requestType.description: Result shape. "scalar" (default) returns one value or a grouped/ranked table over the full time range; use it for totals, percentiles, and top lists. "time_series" returns time-bucketed values, with one series per group when grouped; use it for spikes, trends, changes over time, or questions about when something happened.

timeRange.description: Relative time range. Format: <number><unit> where unit is 'm' (minutes), 'h' (hours), or 'd' (days). Examples: '30m', '1h', '2h', '6h', '24h', '3d', '7d'. Ignored when both start and end are provided. Defaults to '1h'.

tools.name: signoz_check_metric_cardinality
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to find high-cardinality labels or attributes on one metric. It returns keys sorted by cardinality count with sample values, helping distinguish unbounded values such as UUIDs from bounded dimensions such as status codes. Do not use it to find dashboard or alert dependencies (signoz_check_metric_usage) or rank metric ingestion (signoz_get_top_metrics). This does not show whether the metric is used; check usage before recommending a drop.

end.description: End time in unix milliseconds. When both start and end are provided, they override timeRange.

metricName.description: Name of the metric to inspect. Example: 'k8s.container.memory_limit'.

timeRange.description: Relative time range. Format: <number><unit> where unit is 'm' (minutes), 'h' (hours), or 'd' (days). Examples: '30m', '1h', '2h', '6h', '24h', '3d', '7d'. Ignored when both start and end are provided. Defaults to '7d' (a cost-analysis window).

tools.name: signoz_check_metric_usage
tools.description: Use this when the user needs to know which dashboards and alerts reference known metric names, especially before dropping or reducing telemetry. It returns dashboards, alerts, and an error for each metric, with up to 50 unique names per call. Do not use it for ingestion ranking (signoz_get_top_metrics) or label cardinality (signoz_check_metric_cardinality). A non-empty per-metric error means that entry is partial and unreliable; never interpret it as proof that the metric is unused.

metricNames.description: Array of metric name strings to check. Example: ["system.disk.io", "k8s.node.condition"].

tools.name: signoz_create_alert
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a new SigNoz alert rule; use signoz_update_alert to change an existing rule. Supported cases are v2alpha1 threshold alerts over metrics, logs, traces, or exceptions; v2alpha1 PromQL alerts; and metric-only v1 anomaly alerts, which use top-level evalWindow/frequency and no thresholds, evaluation, or schemaVersion. Before composing the payload, read signoz://alert/instructions and signoz://alert/examples; for PromQL also read signoz://promql/instructions. At least one valid notification channel is required, even when notificationSettings.usePolicy=true. Before creating, call signoz_list_notification_channels to verify user-provided names or show available names and ask the user to choose; never guess. If validation still rejects a channel name, show the current names and retry.

alert.description: Name of the alert rule. Must be unique and descriptive.

alertType.description: Signal type: METRIC_BASED_ALERT or LOGS_BASED_ALERT or TRACES_BASED_ALERT or EXCEPTIONS_BASED_ALERT.

annotations.description: Annotations like description and summary. Supports template variables: {{$value}} for current metric value and {{$threshold}} for the threshold and {{$labels.key}} for label values.

condition.description: Alert condition containing the query and threshold configuration.

absentFor.description: Minutes (equivalent to consecutive evaluation cycles when frequency is 1m) to wait with no data before firing an absent-data alert. Example: absentFor=15 with frequency=1m fires after 15 evaluations return no series.

alertOnAbsent.description: Alert when no data is received within the evaluation window.

algorithm.description: v1 (anomaly_rule) only. Anomaly detection algorithm; the supported value is standard (z-score based).

compositeQuery.description: The composite query defining what data to monitor.

panelType.description: Panel type. Use graph for alerts. Defaults to graph.

queries.description: Array of queries. At least one query is required.

aggregations.description: Aggregation expressions for builder queries. For metrics signal use the object shape: [{metricName: k8s.pod.cpu_request_utilization, timeAggregation: avg, spaceAggregation: max}]. For logs/traces use the expression shape: [{expression: count()}] or [{expression: p99(duration_nano)}].

expression.description: Aggregation expression (logs/traces signal). Examples: count(), avg(duration), p99(duration_nano), count_distinct(user_id), sum(bytes). Do not set metricName/timeAggregation/spaceAggregation when using this shape.

metricName.description: Metric name (metrics signal only). Example: k8s.pod.cpu_request_utilization. Use alongside timeAggregation and spaceAggregation. Do not set expression when using this shape.

spaceAggregation.description: Cross-series space aggregation (metrics signal only). Common values: sum, avg, min, max, count. For histograms use percentiles: p50, p75, p90, p95, p99.

timeAggregation.description: Per-series time aggregation (metrics signal only). Common values: avg, max, min, sum, rate, increase, count, count_distinct, latest. Default by metric type: gauge→avg, cumulative counter→rate, delta counter→sum.

expression.description: Formula expression referencing other query names (e.g. A / B * 100). Used for builder_formula type.

filter.description: Filter expression for builder queries. Example: {expression: service.name = frontend AND http.status_code >= 500}.

expression.description: Filter expression using field operators. Example: service.name = frontend AND http.status_code >= 500. Use empty string for no filter.

functions.description: Post-query functions applied to the series. Required for anomaly_rule: wrap with {name: anomaly, args: [{name: z_score_threshold, value: 2}]}.

args.description: Function arguments. Example for anomaly: [{name: z_score_threshold, value: 2}].

name.description: Argument name (e.g. z_score_threshold).

value.description: Argument value. Can be number, string, or bool depending on the function.

name.description: Function name (e.g. anomaly for ruleType=anomaly_rule).

groupBy.description: Fields to group by. Grouped dimensions appear as labels in alert notifications.

fieldContext.description: Field context: resource for resource attributes or tag for span/log attributes. Required for non-top-level fields.

fieldDataType.description: Data type of the field: string or int64 or float64 or bool.

name.description: Field name to group by (e.g. service.name or http.method or severity_text).

having.description: Having clause to filter aggregation results.

expression.description: Filter expression using field operators. Example: service.name = frontend AND http.status_code >= 500. Use empty string for no filter.

limit.description: Positive maximum number of result groups. Use 100 for standalone alert queries and formula results. Use 10000 for each builder query referenced by a formula because input limits are applied before formula evaluation.

name.description: Query name (e.g. A or B or C). Used as reference in formulas and selectedQueryName.

order.description: Query Builder v5 result order. Use __result desc for metrics and formulas; use the primary aggregation descending for logs and traces. This is the wire field order, not dashboard editor orderBy.

name.description: Field or aggregation expression to order by (e.g. timestamp or count()).

query.description: PromQL or ClickHouse SQL query string. Used when queryType is promql or clickhouse_sql. PromQL with OTel dotted metric names MUST use the Prometheus 3.x UTF-8 quoted-selector form: {"metric.name.with.dots"}. Underscored / __name__ / bare-dotted forms return no data. Read signoz://promql/instructions for the full guide (histogram patterns dotted labels pre-flight checklist).

signal.description: Signal type for builder queries: metrics or logs or traces. Required for builder_query type.

source.description: Data-source filter for metrics builder_query only. Set to meter to alert on Cost Meter (usage/billing) metrics such as signoz.meter.log.size; omit otherwise.

stepInterval.description: Step interval in seconds for time aggregation. Use 60 for metrics alerts.

type.description: Query envelope type. Must match compositeQuery.queryType: builder → builder_query or builder_formula; promql → promql; clickhouse_sql → clickhouse_sql. Also accepted: builder_trace_operator for trace operator queries.

queryType.description: Query type: builder for Query Builder or promql for PromQL or clickhouse_sql for ClickHouse SQL.

unit.description: Unit of the queried data (Y-axis unit). Used for value formatting in alert messages and for unit conversion with targetUnit in thresholds. Common values: percent, ms, s, bytes, ns, reqps, ops.

matchType.description: v1 (anomaly_rule) only. Match type - same accepted values as threshold.matchType (at_least_once, all_the_times, on_average/avg, in_total/sum, last).

op.description: v1 (anomaly_rule) only. Comparison operator applied to the anomaly score - same accepted values as threshold.op (above, below, equal, not_equal, above_or_equal, below_or_equal, outside_bounds).

requireMinPoints.description: Require a minimum number of data points before evaluating the condition.

requiredNumPoints.description: Minimum number of data points required when requireMinPoints is true.

seasonality.description: v1 (anomaly_rule) only. Seasonality pattern for anomaly detection: hourly, daily, or weekly.

selectedQueryName.description: Which query name triggers the alert (e.g. A or B or F1). Required when multiple queries exist. Defaults to the first query name.

target.description: v1 (anomaly_rule) only. Threshold value compared against the anomaly score.

thresholds.description: v2alpha1 only (threshold_rule, promql_rule). Each threshold level (critical, error, warning, info) can route to different notification channels. Required unless alertOnAbsent is true. Omit entirely for anomaly_rule - use condition.op/matchType/target there instead.

kind.description: Threshold kind. Currently only basic is supported.

spec.description: Array of threshold specifications. Each threshold can route to different channels.

channels.description: Existing notification channel names for this threshold tier. Verify every name with signoz_list_notification_channels before create/update. The server still requires at least one valid channel in the payload even though routing ignores threshold channels when notificationSettings.usePolicy=true.

matchType.description: How to evaluate the threshold. Canonical: at_least_once, all_the_times, on_average, in_total, last. Aliases accepted: avg (=on_average), sum (=in_total). Numeric 1-5 also accepted but discouraged.

name.description: Threshold tier: critical, error, warning, or info. Also used as the routing label - alerts carry threshold_name equal to this value.

op.description: Comparison operator. Canonical literals: above, below, equal, not_equal, above_or_equal, below_or_equal, outside_bounds. Short forms accepted: eq, not_eq, above_or_eq, below_or_eq. Symbolic accepted: >, <, =, !=, >=, <=. Numeric 1-7 also accepted but discouraged.

recoveryTarget.description: Hysteresis - value at which a firing alert is considered resolved. Useful to avoid flapping near the threshold (e.g. target=80 percent, recoveryTarget=75 percent). Use null to use the threshold target itself as the recovery point.

targetUnit.description: Unit of the threshold target value. If different from compositeQuery.unit the backend converts between them during evaluation. Common values: percent, ms, s, bytes, ns.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this alert monitors.

disabled.description: Whether the alert rule is disabled. Defaults to false (enabled).

evalWindow.description: v1 schema only (anomaly_rule). Evaluation window as a Go duration string (e.g. 5m, 15m, 1h, 24h). For threshold/promql rules, use evaluation.spec.evalWindow instead.

evaluation.description: v2alpha1 only. Evaluation configuration. kind=rolling (sliding window) auto-generated with defaults (5m/1m) if omitted; kind=cumulative (daily/monthly reset) for period-total alerts such as daily error counts or Cost Meter spend budgets. Skipped entirely for anomaly_rule which uses top-level evalWindow/frequency instead.

kind.description: Evaluation kind: rolling (sliding lookback window) or cumulative (accumulates from a fixed daily/monthly reset boundary). Cumulative works for any period-total alert (e.g. daily error counts, monthly request budgets); Cost Meter spend budgets are one common use.

spec.description: Evaluation specification. For kind=rolling set evalWindow + frequency; for kind=cumulative set schedule + frequency + timezone.

evalWindow.description: Rolling kind only. Evaluation window as a Go duration string (e.g. 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h, 24h).

frequency.description: Evaluation frequency as a Go duration string (e.g. 1m, 5m, 15m).

schedule.description: Cumulative kind only. Fixed reset boundary the accumulation window starts from.

hour.description: Hour of the reset boundary (0-23); e.g. 0 for midnight.

minute.description: Minute of the reset boundary (0-59); e.g. 0 for the top of the hour.

type.description: Reset cadence: daily or monthly.

timezone.description: Cumulative kind only. IANA timezone for the schedule boundary (e.g. UTC).

frequency.description: v1 schema only (anomaly_rule). Evaluation frequency as a Go duration string (e.g. 1m, 5m, 3h). For threshold/promql rules, use evaluation.spec.frequency instead.

labels.description: Labels for the alert rule. MUST include severity (one of critical, error, warning, info). When thresholds is used, threshold.name (e.g. critical) acts as the routing tier - set labels.severity to match the highest tier you want this rule to carry. Additional labels like team/service/environment enable routing policies.

notificationSettings.description: v2alpha1 only. Notification settings - controls grouping and re-notification behavior. Auto-generated with defaults if omitted.

groupBy.description: Fields to group alert notifications by (e.g. service.name, k8s.namespace.name). Reduces notification noise by batching alerts with the same group key.

newGroupEvalDelay.description: Grace period (Go duration string, e.g. 2m) during which a newly-appearing label group is excluded from evaluation. Helps avoid flapping when new pods/services come online.

alertStates.description: Alert states that trigger re-notification. Accepted values: firing, nodata. Other values are rejected.

interval.description: Re-notification interval as a Go duration string (e.g. 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h).

usePolicy.description: Routing mode. false (default) sends to per-threshold channels; true routes through the org-level policy matching on labels. The server still requires at least one existing channel name in the payload when this is true.

preferredChannels.description: Existing notification channel names. Before create/update, verify every name with signoz_list_notification_channels; never guess. The current MCP validation requires at least one valid channel reference across preferredChannels or thresholds.spec[].channels.

ruleType.description: Evaluation type: threshold_rule (compare against value) or promql_rule (PromQL expression) or anomaly_rule (anomaly detection on metrics).

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. Set to v2alpha1 automatically for threshold_rule/promql_rule. Must be omitted (or empty) for anomaly_rule.

searchContext.description: Copy the user's entire original request verbatim, including any preflight or confirmation context; do not summarize, shorten, or omit clauses.

source.description: Source URL for the alert. Set automatically.

version.description: API version. Always v5. Set automatically if omitted.

tools.name: signoz_create_dashboard
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a custom SigNoz dashboard built from a complete title, layout, variables, and widget configuration; use signoz_import_dashboard instead when a curated template fits. Use signoz_create_view instead to save one Explorer query. Before composing the payload, read signoz://dashboard/instructions, signoz://dashboard/widgets-instructions, and signoz://dashboard/widgets-examples, then follow the query-specific resource linked by the widget guide.

description.description: Concise explanation of the operational questions this dashboard answers.

layout.description: Grid positions for widgets on a 12-column layout. Each non-row widget ID must have one matching layout item; the server auto-generates layout only when this array is empty.

i.description: Widget ID positioned by this item. Must exactly match one widgets[].id and be unique in the layout.

isDraggable.description: Frontend-only drag-state hint; the current dashboard write normalizer does not persist it.

maxH.description: Frontend-only maximum-height hint; the current dashboard write normalizer does not persist it.

minH.description: Frontend-only minimum-height hint; the current dashboard write normalizer does not persist it.

minW.description: Frontend-only minimum-width hint; the current dashboard write normalizer does not persist it.

moved.description: Frontend layout state; normally false or omitted.

static.description: Whether the widget is fixed in the grid. Default false.

w.description: Widget width in grid columns; the full grid is 12 columns.

x.description: Zero-based horizontal grid coordinate; x + w cannot exceed 12.

searchContext.description: Copy the user's entire original request verbatim, including any preflight or confirmation context; do not summarize, shorten, or omit clauses.

tags.description: Free-form categorization tags, for example performance or latency.

title.description: The display name of the dashboard.

allSelected.description: Frontend-only all-values selection state; the current dashboard write normalizer does not persist it.

customValue.description: Comma-separated or UI-encoded values for a CUSTOM variable.

defaultValue.description: Default value applied when the variable has no explicit selection.

description.description: Concise statement of what this variable controls.

dynamicVariablesAttribute.description: Attribute name populated by a DYNAMIC variable, for example service.name.

dynamicVariablesSource.description: Signal source for a DYNAMIC variable: Traces, Logs, Metrics, or All telemetry. Legacy casing and all sources are normalized on write.

haveCustomValuesSelected.description: Frontend-only custom-value selection state; the current dashboard write normalizer does not persist it.

id.description: Stable variable UUID. The server generates one when omitted.

key.description: Frontend-only variable-key alias; the current write normalizer derives identity from the variables map key and does not persist this field.

modificationUUID.description: Frontend-only modification token; the current dashboard write normalizer does not persist it.

multiSelect.description: Whether multiple values may be selected. Defaults to true for DYNAMIC variables when omitted.

name.description: Variable name shown in the UI. Defaults to the variables map key.

order.description: Zero-based display order. Generated from map iteration order when omitted, so set it explicitly for deterministic ordering.

queryValue.description: Query expression used by a QUERY variable.

selectedValue.description: Current selected value or values; preserve the shape returned by signoz_get_dashboard on update.

showALLOption.description: Whether to expose an all-values choice. Defaults to true for DYNAMIC variables when omitted.

sort.description: Value sorting: ASC, DESC, or DISABLED. Defaults to ASC for DYNAMIC variables and DISABLED otherwise.

textboxValue.description: Current text for a TEXTBOX variable.

type.description: Variable type: QUERY, TEXTBOX, DYNAMIC, or CUSTOM. Defaults to DYNAMIC when omitted.

variables.description: Map keyed by variable name. Query widgets reference variables with a dollar-sign prefix, for example $service_name.

widgets.description: Dashboard panels. Each typed widget needs a unique ID, title, panelTypes value, and query. The current MCP schema requires the query envelope even for row separators.

bucketCount.description: Number of histogram buckets; histogram default is 30.

bucketWidth.description: Optional fixed histogram bucket width in the widget's yAxisUnit.

columnUnits.description: Table column-name to SigNoz unit mapping.

contextLinks.description: Links shown from this widget to related SigNoz or external context.

linksData.description: Context-link definitions. Preserve entries returned by signoz_get_dashboard; use an empty list when no links are configured.

customLegendColors.description: Series/query name to hex color mapping, for example A to #3366FF.

decimalPrecision.description: Number of decimal places to display. Omit to use the frontend default.

description.description: Concise explanation of what the widget measures or lists.

fillSpans.description: Whether a timeseries fills gaps between data points. Default false.

id.description: Unique widget ID. The matching layout item uses this value in layout[].i.

isLogScale.description: Whether supported charts use a logarithmic y-axis. Default false.

isStacked.description: Frontend-only stacking flag that the current write normalizer does not persist. Use stackedBarChart for bar panels.

legendPosition.description: Legend position: bottom or right. Omit when the panel type has no legend.

mergeAllActiveQueries.description: Whether histogram results from all active queries are merged. Default false.

nullZeroValues.description: How absent numeric points are rendered. Defaults to zero when omitted.

opacity.description: Numeric opacity encoded as a string. Defaults to 1.

panelTypes.description: Panel type: graph, value, table, list, trace, bar, pie, histogram, or row. Runtime treats row as a separator, but the current MCP input schema still requires its query envelope.

query.description: Complete widget query. Choose exactly one queryType and populate its matching builder, clickhouse_sql, or promql envelope.

builder.description: Query Builder queries and formulas when queryType is builder. Read signoz://dashboard/query-builder-example first.

queryData.description: Base Query Builder queries. Include at least one when queryType is builder; formulas refer to their queryName values.

aggregateAttribute.description: Field aggregated by aggregateOperator. Leave empty for count() or when aggregations supplies the v5 metric shape.

dataType.description: Field data type reported by SigNoz, for example string, int64, float64, or bool.

fieldContext.description: Field namespace required by selectColumns, such as resource, span, or log.

fieldDataType.description: Frontend field type required by selectColumns, for example string or int64.

id.description: Frontend attribute identifier; preserve it on update when present.

isColumn.description: Whether the field is a materialized storage column.

isJSON.description: Whether the field contains JSON values.

key.description: Attribute key used by groupBy and filters, for example service.name. Prefer key in these contexts.

name.description: Field name used by selectColumns and order entries. Prefer name in those contexts.

signal.description: Owning signal required by selectColumns: traces, logs, or metrics.

type.description: Attribute namespace reported by SigNoz, such as resource, tag, span, or log.

aggregateOperator.description: Aggregation applied to aggregateAttribute. Stable common values include noop, count, count_distinct, sum, avg, min, max, p50, p75, p90, p95, p99, rate, rate_sum, rate_avg, rate_min, and rate_max; valid values depend on dataSource.

aggregations.description: Query Builder v5 aggregation definitions. Metrics use metricName/timeAggregation/spaceAggregation; logs and traces use expression.

expression.description: Logs/traces aggregation expression, for example count() or p95(duration_nano). Leave empty for metric aggregations.

metricName.description: Exact metric name for a metrics aggregation. Discover it with signoz_list_metrics when unknown.

reduceTo.description: Optional reduction for this aggregation: last, sum, avg, min, or max.

spaceAggregation.description: Required metrics space aggregation: sum, avg, min, max, count, p50, p75, p90, p95, or p99.

temporality.description: Optional metric temporality: Unspecified, Delta, or Cumulative.

source.description: Data-source filter for metrics builder_query only. Set to meter to alert on Cost Meter (usage/billing) metrics such as signoz.meter.log.size; omit otherwise.

stepInterval.description: Step interval in seconds for time aggregation. Use 60 for metrics alerts.

type.description: Query envelope type. Must match compositeQuery.queryType: builder → builder_query or builder_formula; promql → promql; clickhouse_sql → clickhouse_sql. Also accepted: builder_trace_operator for trace operator queries.

matchType.description: v1 (anomaly_rule) only. Match type - same accepted values as threshold.matchType (at_least_once, all_the_times, on_average/avg, in_total/sum, last).

op.description: v1 (anomaly_rule) only. Comparison operator applied to the anomaly score - same accepted values as threshold.op (above, below, equal, not_equal, above_or_equal, below_or_equal, outside_bounds).

requireMinPoints.description: Require a minimum number of data points before evaluating the condition.

requiredNumPoints.description: Minimum number of data points required when requireMinPoints is true.

seasonality.description: v1 (anomaly_rule) only. Seasonality pattern for anomaly detection: hourly, daily, or weekly.

selectedQueryName.description: Which query name triggers the alert (e.g. A or B or F1). Required when multiple queries exist. Defaults to the first query name.

target.description: v1 (anomaly_rule) only. Threshold value compared against the anomaly score.

thresholds.description: v2alpha1 only (threshold_rule, promql_rule). Each threshold level (critical, error, warning, info) can route to different notification channels. Required unless alertOnAbsent is true. Omit entirely for anomaly_rule - use condition.op/matchType/target there instead.

spec.description: Array of threshold specifications. Each threshold can route to different channels.

matchType.description: How to evaluate the threshold. Canonical: at_least_once, all_the_times, on_average, in_total, last. Aliases accepted: avg (=on_average), sum (=in_total). Numeric 1-5 also accepted but discouraged.

name.description: Threshold tier: critical, error, warning, or info. Also used as the routing label - alerts carry threshold_name equal to this value.

op.description: Comparison operator. Canonical literals: above, below, equal, not_equal, above_or_equal, below_or_equal, outside_bounds. Short forms accepted: eq, not_eq, above_or_eq, below_or_eq. Symbolic accepted: >, <, =, !=, >=, <=. Numeric 1-7 also accepted but discouraged.

recoveryTarget.description: Hysteresis - value at which a firing alert is considered resolved. Useful to avoid flapping near the threshold (e.g. target=80 percent, recoveryTarget=75 percent). Use null to use the threshold target itself as the recovery point.

targetUnit.description: Unit of the threshold target value. If different from compositeQuery.unit the backend converts between them during evaluation. Common values: percent, ms, s, bytes, ns.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this alert monitors.

disabled.description: Whether the alert rule is disabled. Defaults to false (enabled).

evalWindow.description: v1 schema only (anomaly_rule). Evaluation window as a Go duration string (e.g. 5m, 15m, 1h, 24h). For threshold/promql rules, use evaluation.spec.evalWindow instead.

evaluation.description: v2alpha1 only. Evaluation configuration. kind=rolling (sliding window) auto-generated with defaults (5m/1m) if omitted; kind=cumulative (daily/monthly reset) for period-total alerts such as daily error counts or Cost Meter spend budgets. Skipped entirely for anomaly_rule which uses top-level evalWindow/frequency instead.

kind.description: Evaluation kind: rolling (sliding lookback window) or cumulative (accumulates from a fixed daily/monthly reset boundary). Cumulative works for any period-total alert (e.g. daily error counts, monthly request budgets); Cost Meter spend budgets are one common use.

spec.description: Evaluation specification. For kind=rolling set evalWindow + frequency; for kind=cumulative set schedule + frequency + timezone.

evalWindow.description: Rolling kind only. Evaluation window as a Go duration string (e.g. 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h, 24h).

frequency.description: Evaluation frequency as a Go duration string (e.g. 1m, 5m, 15m).

schedule.description: Cumulative kind only. Fixed reset boundary the accumulation window starts from.

hour.description: Hour of the reset boundary (0-23); e.g. 0 for midnight.

minute.description: Minute of the reset boundary (0-59); e.g. 0 for the top of the hour.

type.description: Reset cadence: daily or monthly.

timezone.description: Cumulative kind only. IANA timezone for the schedule boundary (e.g. UTC).

frequency.description: v1 schema only (anomaly_rule). Evaluation frequency as a Go duration string (e.g. 1m, 5m, 3h). For threshold/promql rules, use evaluation.spec.frequency instead.

id.description: UUIDv7 of the alert rule to update (required). Obtain it from signoz_list_alert_rules or signoz_get_alert.

labels.description: Labels for the alert rule. MUST include severity (one of critical, error, warning, info). groupBy.description: Fields to group alert notifications by (e.g. service.name, k8s.namespace.name). Reduces notification noise by batching alerts with the same group key.

newGroupEvalDelay.description: Grace period (Go duration string, e.g. 2m) during which a newly-appearing label group is excluded from evaluation. Helps avoid flapping when new pods/services come online.

alertStates.description: Alert states that trigger re-notification. Accepted values: firing, nodata. Other values are rejected.

interval.description: Re-notification interval as a Go duration string (e.g. 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h).

usePolicy.description: Routing mode. false (default) sends to per-threshold channels; true routes through the org-level policy matching on labels. The server still requires at least one existing channel name in the payload when this is true.

ruleType.description: Evaluation type: threshold_rule (compare against value) or promql_rule (PromQL expression) or anomaly_rule (anomaly detection on metrics).

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. Set to v2alpha1 automatically for threshold_rule/promql_rule. Must be omitted (or empty) for anomaly_rule.

searchContext.description: Copy the user's entire original request verbatim, including any preflight or confirmation context; do not summarize, shorten, or omit clauses.

source.description: Source URL for the alert. Set automatically.

version.description: API version. Always v5. Set automatically if omitted.

spaceAggregation.description: Metric space aggregation across series: sum, avg, min, max, count, p50, p75, p90, p95, or p99. Omit for logs and traces.

stepInterval.description: Time bucket width in seconds. Use 0 for raw list queries; choose a positive interval for timeseries queries.

temporality.description: Metric temporality: Unspecified, Delta, or Cumulative. Omit for logs and traces.

timeAggregation.description: Metric time aggregation: latest, sum, avg, min, max, count, count_distinct, rate, or increase. Omit for logs and traces.

queryTraceOperator.description: Trace-operator definitions used by specialized trace queries. Preserve returned entries on update; otherwise omit.

clickhouse_sql.description: Raw ClickHouse SQL queries when queryType is clickhouse_sql. Read the signal-specific schema and examples resources first.

disabled.description: Whether this base query is hidden from panel output. Set true when it only feeds a formula.

legend.description: Legend template for naming ClickHouse query series. Use {{column_name}} placeholders for label columns returned by the query result. REQUIRED for grouped or multi-series charts. Example: {{service_name}} or {{service_name}} - {{http_method}}. Only columns present in the result can be used in the legend.

name.description: Query reference name, conventionally A, B, and so on.

query.description: Raw ClickHouse SQL. Return a timestamp and value for timeseries panels and use the exact bundled-or-tenant schema column names.

id.description: Stable frontend query UUID. The server generates one when omitted.

promql.description: PromQL queries when queryType is promql. Read signoz://promql/instructions before composing dotted OTel metric names.

disabled.description: Whether this base query is hidden from panel output. Set true when it only feeds a formula.

legend.description: Legend template for naming PromQL series. Use {{label_name}} placeholders matching labels returned by the query. REQUIRED for grouped or multi-series charts. Example: {{service_name}} or {{service_name}} - {{instance}}. Without legend charts show generic series names.

name.description: Query reference name, conventionally A, B, and so on.

query.description: PromQL query expression. For OTel metrics with dots in the name use the Prometheus 3.x UTF-8 quoted-selector form: {"metric.name.with.dots"}. Underscored / __name__ / bare-dotted forms return no data in SigNoz. Read signoz://promql/instructions for the full guide.

queryType.description: Query engine: builder, clickhouse_sql, or promql. Populate the matching sibling field and leave the other query arrays empty.

queryData.description: Frontend-only query state; the current dashboard write normalizer does not persist it. Use query for authored widgets.

queryType.description: Frontend-only query-type state; the current dashboard write normalizer does not persist it. Use query.queryType for authored widgets.

selectedLogFields.description: Columns shown by a logs list panel. Leave empty when not applicable.

dataType.description: Underlying field data type, for example string, int64, or bool.

fieldContext.description: Field namespace, such as resource or log.

fieldDataType.description: Frontend field data type when it differs from dataType.

isColumn.description: Whether the field is a materialized column.

isIndexed.description: Whether the target tenant indexes this field.

isJSON.description: Whether the field contains JSON values.

name.description: Log field name displayed as a list column.

signal.description: Signal owning the field. Use logs for selectedLogFields.

type.description: Attribute type, such as resource, tag, or log.

selectedTracesFields.description: Columns shown by a traces list panel. Leave empty when not applicable.

dataType.description: Field data type reported by SigNoz, for example string, int64, float64, or bool.

fieldContext.description: Field namespace required by selectColumns, such as resource, span, or log.

fieldDataType.description: Frontend field type required by selectColumns, for example string or int64.

id.description: Frontend attribute identifier; preserve it on update when present.

isColumn.description: Whether the field is a materialized storage column.

isJSON.description: Whether the field contains JSON values.

key.description: Attribute key used by groupBy and filters, for example service.name. Prefer key in these contexts.

name.description: Field name used by selectColumns and order entries. Prefer name in those contexts.

signal.description: Owning signal required by selectColumns: traces, logs, or metrics.

type.description: Attribute namespace reported by SigNoz, such as resource, tag, span, or log.

softMax.description: Optional soft upper display bound in yAxisUnit; it does not filter data.

softMin.description: Optional soft lower display bound in yAxisUnit; it does not filter data.

stackedBarChart.description: Whether a bar panel stacks grouped series. Default false.

thresholds.description: Visual thresholds. These color a widget; they do not create alert rules.

index.description: Stable identifier for this threshold within the widget.

isEditEnabled.description: Frontend edit state; normally false or omitted.

keyIndex.description: Frontend ordering index for this threshold.

selectedGraph.description: Query or series the threshold applies to; preserve it when updating an existing threshold.

thresholdFormat.description: How the threshold is rendered. Allowed values: 'Text' or 'Background'. SigNoz does NOT support a Grafana-style 'Line' marker; do not use 'Line'. 'Background' tints the panel area when the operator+value condition holds; 'Text' colors the threshold value label only.

thresholdLabel.description: Optional display label for the threshold.

thresholdTableOptions.description: Table threshold display option; preserve the value returned by signoz_get_dashboard.

thresholdUnit.description: Unit for the threshold value (should match the panel's yAxisUnit).

thresholdValue.description: Numeric value the operator is compared against.

timePreferance.description: Time range mode. Use GLOBAL_TIME; this intentionally matches the frontend's timePreferance spelling and defaults to GLOBAL_TIME.

title.description: Widget title displayed on the dashboard.

yAxisUnit.description: SigNoz unit identifier for values and the y-axis, for example ms, s, bytes, percentunit, or none.

id.description: Dashboard UUID to update (required).

tools.name: signoz_update_notification_channel
tools.description:
Use this when the user wants to change an existing SigNoz notification channel. This is a full replacement: first find the ID with signoz_list_notification_channels, then call signoz_get_notification_channel and merge the requested change while preserving the complete provider configuration and send_resolved value. Omitting send_resolved resets it to true. A test notification is sent after update; an update can succeed even when that test fails, which is reported in the response.
SUPPORTED TYPES: slack, webhook, pagerduty, email, opsgenie, msteams

Do not use this for partial updates.

email_html.description: Custom HTML email template (Go template syntax supported)

email_to.description: Comma-separated list of email addresses. Required when type=email

id.description: Notification channel UUID. Obtain it from signoz_list_notification_channels.

msteams_text.description: Message body template (Go template syntax supported)

msteams_title.description: Message title template (Go template syntax supported)

msteams_webhook_url.description: MS Teams incoming webhook URL. Required when type=msteams

name.description: Complete replacement channel name. Preserve the current name unless the user requested a change.

opsgenie_api_key.description: OpsGenie API key. Required when type=opsgenie

opsgenie_priority.description: Alert priority: P1, P2, P3, P4, or P5

pagerduty_routing_key.description: PagerDuty integration/routing key. Required when type=pagerduty

pagerduty_severity.description: Incident severity: critical, error, warning, or info

searchContext.description: Copy the user's entire original request verbatim, including any preflight or confirmation context; do not summarize, shorten, or omit clauses.

send_resolved.description: Complete replacement resolved-notification setting. Copy the current value from signoz_get_notification_channel unless changing it; omission resets to true.

slack_api_url.description: Slack incoming webhook URL. Required when type=slack. Example: https://hooks.slack.com/services/T.../B.../xxx

slack_channel.description: Slack channel or username to post to. Example: '#alerts' or '@oncall'

slack_text.description: Message body template (Go template syntax supported)

slack_title.description: Message title template (Go template syntax supported)

type.description: Complete replacement channel type: slack, webhook, pagerduty, email, opsgenie, or msteams. Preserve the current type unless the user requested a change.

webhook_url.description: Webhook endpoint URL. Required when type=webhook

tools.name: signoz_update_view
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to change an existing saved Explorer view. This is a full replacement: call signoz_get_view first, modify its data object, preserve every unrequested field, and pass that full object as view. Read signoz://view/instructions and signoz://view/examples when changing sourcePage or compositeQuery; skip them for name-, category-, or tags-only changes when you already have the complete fetched view. Keep the UUID only in id; omit server-populated IDs and timestamps from view.

id.description: UUID of the view to replace. Required.

searchContext.description: Copy the user's entire original request verbatim, including any preflight or confirmation context; do not summarize, shorten, or omit clauses.

view.description: Complete saved view after the requested changes. Start with the data returned by signoz_get_view and pass the full object here.

compositeQuery.description: The Query Builder payload as an object (not a string). Must contain queryType plus matching sub-query. See signoz://view/instructions and signoz://view/examples.

extraData.description: Optional UI-controlled options as a JSON-encoded string (safe to leave empty).

name.description: Display name of the view.

sourcePage.description: Which Explorer this view belongs to. One of: "traces", "logs", "metrics", "meter". Use "meter" for Cost Meter views (queried as metrics with source "meter").

resources.name: Alert Rule Examples
resources.description: Read this after signoz://alert/instructions when you need alert payload examples for metrics, logs, traces, exceptions, PromQL, anomalies, formulas, tiered thresholds, cumulative alerts, or notification settings. Verify every example channel name with signoz_list_notification_channels.

resources.name: Alert Rule Instructions
resources.description: Read this before creating or updating an alert. It explains fields, rule types, queries, thresholds, evaluation, and notification setup. For payload examples, read signoz://alert/examples.

resources.name: ClickHouse Logs Examples
resources.description: Read this after signoz://dashboard/clickhouse-schema-for-logs when composing a raw ClickHouse logs widget. It covers timestamp and attribute filters, resource CTEs, variables, timeseries/value shapes, and performance patterns.

resources.name: ClickHouse Logs Schema
resources.description: Read this before writing ClickHouse SQL for a dashboard widget over SigNoz logs. It lists tables and columns from the schema bundled with this server. Also read signoz://dashboard/clickhouse-logs-example. If the live SigNoz instance rejects a table or column, follow that error because the bundled schema may lag.

resources.name: ClickHouse Metrics Examples
resources.description: Read this after signoz://dashboard/clickhouse-schema-for-metrics when composing a raw ClickHouse metrics widget. It covers counter rates, error ratios, histogram quantiles, time-series tables, variables, and performance patterns.

resources.name: ClickHouse Metrics Schema
resources.description: Read this before writing ClickHouse SQL for a dashboard widget over SigNoz metrics. It lists tables and columns from the schema bundled with this server. Also read signoz://dashboard/clickhouse-metrics-example. If the live SigNoz instance rejects a table or column, follow that error because the bundled schema may lag.

resources.name: ClickHouse Traces Examples
resources.description: Read this after signoz://dashboard/clickhouse-schema-for-traces when composing a raw ClickHouse traces widget. It covers resource filters, timeseries/value/table result shapes, span events, latency analysis, and performance patterns.

resources.name: ClickHouse Traces Schema
resources.description: Read this before writing ClickHouse SQL for a dashboard widget over SigNoz traces. It lists tables and columns from the schema bundled with this server. Also read signoz://dashboard/clickhouse-traces-example. If the live SigNoz instance rejects a table or column, follow that error because the bundled schema may lag.

resources.name: Dashboard Basic Instructions
resources.description: Read this before creating or fully replacing a dashboard. It explains dashboard fields, metadata, variables, variable chaining, and layout. Also read signoz://dashboard/widgets-instructions for widget and query choices.

resources.name: Dashboard Widget Instructions
resources.description: Read this when choosing or building dashboard widgets. It explains when to use each panel type, required layout and legend fields, and which detailed guide to read for each query type. Also read signoz://dashboard/instructions.

resources.name: Dashboard Widgets Examples
resources.description: Read this after the dashboard and widget instructions when building panels. It includes examples by panel type, validation checks, troubleshooting, and grouped-series legends. Verify field names in the target SigNoz workspace.

resources.name: Logs Query Builder Guide
resources.description: Read this before writing Query Builder v5 JSON for logs or filtering on unfamiliar log fields. It explains filter syntax, field discovery, body and JSON-path search, row and aggregate queries, stable pagination, limits, ordering, timestamps, and examples for rows, single values, and time series.

resources.name: Metrics Aggregation Guide
resources.description: Read this before choosing aggregations for signoz_query_metrics or building metrics Query Builder JSON. It explains timeAggregation, spaceAggregation, and reduceTo by metric type; formulas and limits; how groupBy field context is inferred; top-N selection across the full window; step intervals; examples; and Cost Meter queries.

resources.name: PromQL Instructions
resources.description: Read this when composing a PromQL dashboard widget or promql_rule alert. It explains SigNoz's Prometheus 3.x quoted-selector form for dotted OTel metric names, resource labels, examples, and query checks; do not use it for Query Builder or ClickHouse SQL.

resources.name: Query Builder Examples
resources.description: Read this when composing a Query Builder dashboard widget. It covers signal-specific aggregations, filters, metric naming, grouped legends, functions, and examples; use the ClickHouse or PromQL resources instead for those query types.

resources.name: Saved View Examples
resources.description: Read this after signoz://view/instructions when composing a saved Explorer view. It provides complete Query Builder v5 payloads for traces, logs, metrics, and Cost Meter source pages.

resources.name: Saved View Instructions
resources.description: Read this before creating or updating a saved Explorer view. It explains view fields, sourcePage, Query Builder v5, Cost Meter views, and how to read a view before replacing it. It does not describe dashboards.

resources.name: SigNoz Docs Sitemap
resources.description: Use this resource when an MCP client needs the indexed official SigNoz documentation catalog and page URLs. Use signoz_search_docs for topical discovery and signoz_fetch_doc for page content.

resources.name: Traces Query Builder Guide
resources.description: Read this before writing Query Builder v5 JSON for traces or filtering on unfamiliar trace fields. It explains filter syntax, field discovery, built-in span fields, row and aggregate queries, limits, ordering, timestamps, and examples for rows, single values, and time series.

resourceTemplates.name: Alert Definition and Recent History
resourceTemplates.description: Use this resource with a rule ID from signoz_list_alert_rules to read one live alert definition and up to 10 history records from the preceding six hours. Use signoz_get_alert or signoz_get_alert_history when a tool call is preferred.

resourceTemplates.name: Dashboard Definition
resourceTemplates.description: Use this resource with an ID from signoz_list_dashboards to read the full live dashboard definition, including widgets and variables. Use signoz_get_dashboard when a tool call is preferred.
